decisions.reason: A safety shoe line is the firm's core business, and a large firm with ample inventory and slack has no shortfall signal prompting it to search for alternatives.
A low-cost comfort insole complements the shoe range and sells through the existing channels, so the slack can carry it despite its modest visibility.
The supportive insole overlaps with the other insoles and only gets a mention, but its cost of carrying is small relative to the firm's slack, so it stays absent clear underperformance.
Its own dedicated page signals that the ergonomic series meets management's aspirations and fits the innovation focus, so there is no reason to drop it.
Firefighter boots serve a specialised segment with long procurement cycles, which justifies keeping them while results are still uncertain, given the firm's slack.
As the home-page flagship, the moulded insole carries strategic commitment, making it very unlikely to be withdrawn so soon.
